ashwick_tack_room_key.name: Tack-Room Key
ashwick_tack_room_key.description: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER ITEM) An iron key tagged for the boathouse tack room. Maela carries one; a spare may be hidden in the boathouse.

ivo_token.name: Ivo's Bell Token
ivo_token.description: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER ITEM) A palm-sized bronze token stamped with a ferry oar. The bell rope will accept it.
